fixes.explanation: It's true. Jesus says, “If someone strikes you on one cheek, turn to him the other also.” That's the exact line. It comes right after He says, “…pray for those who mistreat you.” So turning the other cheek is one of His examples of loving your enemies: when someone strikes you, you answer with love instead of striking back.

problems.problem: The explanation repeats the instruction but does not explain what turning the other cheek means.
